steps.name: Setup git
steps.script:
git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

steps.name: Push update
steps.script:
final_lock="$RUNNER_TEMP/flake-update-final.lock"
git show HEAD:flake.lock > "$final_lock"
nix shell "$CONFCTL_FLAKE" -c confctl inputs check-update \
  --old-lock "$UPDATE_OLD_LOCK" --new-lock "$final_lock"

integration.network: Native test framework defaults; no --network switch exists in pinned CLI. No development cluster.
integration.reason: Only registered test; ordered examples share state and pinned CLI has no example selector.
